HOG_2012_p35__paragraph_3.ocr:
During 2011, wholesale shipments of Harley-Davidson motorcycles were up 10.7% compared to the prior year. 
Temporary production constraints resulting from restructuring efforts at the Company’s York facility that impacted its 
production for 2011 eased during the fourth quarter of 2011, allowing a slightly higher mix of Touring motorcycles compared 
to the prior year. Sportster shipment mix was also higher than in 2010 and near the high end of the historical range of 18% to 
22% due to strong retail demand for Sportster models.
